inputs.text: Israel's parliament began debating today on a bill that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. The bill's passage would be a victory for Israel's far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir, leader of the religious party that introduced the legislation. Opponents of the legislation call it racist, draconian and unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants.
